message:
The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and I couldn't help but chuckle as my kids turned into little survival experts. They grabbed every flashlight we owned, creating a mini lantern parade through the house. I tried to keep things calm, reminding them that we have power banks for our phones and plenty of snacks to keep us fueled. 

As we set up a cozy little spot on the living room floor, I realized that these moments are what truly bring us together. 

So, I guess my tip is to embrace the unexpected and keep your favorite snacks and power banks handy. Who knew a blackout could turn into such a fun family night? What are your go-to tips for staying cozy during a power outage? 😊
